title: PHPBenelux Conference 2027, Antwerp Belgium
content: PHPBenelux is back! After 11 successful editions, the leading PHP conference in Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg is back for a one-day event on Saturday January 23 2027. Join us in Antwerp for a new chapter of technical excellence, community, and connection. , and visit for more information about the conference. Buy your tickets herehttps://conference.phpbenelux.eu
